name: web-sports-wellness-long-landing-page-with-giant-wordmark
title: Sports Wellness Landing with Giant Wordmark
whatItIs: A tall landing page for a sports wellness brand: a hero photo of a basketball with a giant white wordmark, inline icon chips in headlines, tennis and basketball photo cards, a black events list with an orange highlighted row, testimonials and a footer with a cropped giant wordmark.
whatItMeans: Photography with bright orange accents feels athletic and lively, and giant wordmarks bookend the page.
techniques: Giant wordmark overlapped by the hero photo
Black list section with an orange highlighted row
Rounded photo cards with overlay data cards
Cropped wordmark as a footer graphic

vocabulary.definition: A brand name set at enormous scale.
A small image or icon placed inside a headline.
One list row filled with the accent colour.
